reason: Several speakers directly challenged his claims. Adam Becker and Anil Dash disputed that training is worth more than royalties to most authors. Leslie Chan disputed his framing of refusal as self-erasure. Ramón Alvarado and Adam Becker disputed his data-scarcity point on grounds of synthetic data and model collapse. He has not yet answered any of them.

Leslie Chan directly challenged his claim that CC0 forkability is the real guard, arguing that forkability protects only those with the resources to fork. Chan also argued that CC0 release lets outsiders extract value from Global South and Indigenous knowledge first. He has not had a chance to respond.
